message.content:
The **Union Square Greenmarket** is widely regarded as the most‑visited market in New York City.  
It’s the largest of the city’s farmers’ markets, drawing roughly 1 million visitors each year (the 2022 figure was about 1.1 million). The market’s central location, long operating hours, and wide variety of fresh produce, artisanal foods, and local products make it a top destination for both locals and tourists.
